=== one row
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	nop
=== rows, columns and advances
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 1 0
	nop
	.loc 1 2 0
	nop
	nop
	.loc 1 3 4
	nop
=== a row on the line of the one before
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 3 1
	nop
	.loc 1 3 5
	nop
	.loc 1 4 1
	nop
	.loc 1 4 1
	nop
=== line going backwards
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 40
	nop
	.loc 1 2
	nop
	.loc 1 2000
	nop
=== flags and options
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 3 1
	nop
	.loc 1 4 3 is_stmt 0
	nop
	.loc 1 5 7 discriminator 3
	nop
	.loc 1 6 prologue_end
	nop
	.loc 1 7 epilogue_begin
	nop
	.loc 1 8 basic_block
	nop
	.loc 1 9 isa 2
	nop
	.loc 1 10 is_stmt 1
	nop
	.loc 1 11
	nop
=== column and isa carry over, or not
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 5 3 isa 1
	nop
	.loc 1 6
	nop
	.loc 1 7 0
	nop
=== two sequences
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.file 2 "b.h"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	nop
	.loc 2 20 2
	nop
	.section .text.other,"ax"
	.loc 1 30
	nop
	nop
	.text
	.loc 1 2
	nop
=== consecutive locs and one left over
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	nop
	.loc 1 5
	.loc 1 6
	nop
	.loc 1 7
=== what a loc waits for
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	.byte 1, 2, 3, 4
	.loc 1 2
	.long 5
	.loc 1 3
	.p2align 4
	nop
	.loc 1 4
label:
	nop
	.loc 1 11
	.space 4
	.loc 1 12
	.ascii "abcd"
	.loc 1 13
	.skip 4, 0
	.loc 1 14
	.fill 2, 2, 0
	.loc 1 15
	.uleb128 300
	.loc 1 16
	nop
=== a loc across a section switch
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	nop
	.loc 1 9
	.data
	.byte 0, 0, 0, 0
	.text
	nop
	.loc 1 10
	.pushsection .data
	.long 1
	.popsection
	nop
=== line zero
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 5
	nop
	.loc 1 0
	nop
	.loc 1 6
	nop
=== large address advances
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	nop
	.loc 1 2
	.skip 68
	nop
	.loc 1 3
	.skip 80
	nop
	.loc 1 4
	.skip 300
	nop
	.loc 1 5
	.skip 70000
	nop
	.loc 1 6
	.skip 36
=== data after the last row
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	nop
	.skip 40
=== directories in file names
	.file 1 "src/a.c"
	.file 2 "/usr/include/stdio.h"
	.file 3 "src/b.h"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	nop
	.loc 2 2
	nop
	.loc 3 3
	nop
=== a file table with no rows
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	nop
=== DWARF 5 with file 0
	.file 0 "/work/dir" "src/a.c" md5 0x00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff
	.file 1 "src/b.c" md5 0x0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f10
	.file 2 "/usr/include/stdio.h" md5 0xffeeddccbbaa99887766554433221100
	.text
	.loc 0 1
	nop
	.loc 1 2
	nop
	.loc 2 3
	nop
=== DWARF 5 without checksums
	.file 0 "/w" "a.c"
	.file 1 "a1.c"
	.file 2 "/usr/include" "stdio.h"
	.file 3 "sub/b.h"
	.file 4 "/abs/c.h"
	.file 5 "/w/d.h"
	.file 6 "/w" "e.h"
	.file 7 "sub" "f.h"
	.text
	.loc 0 1
	nop
	.loc 1 2
	nop
	.loc 3 3
	nop
	.loc 4 4
	nop
	.loc 7 5
	nop
=== a frame
	.text
	.globl f
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	nop
	.cfi_offset 3, -16
	nop
	.cfi_restore 3
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== every instruction
	.text
	.globl f
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 24
	.cfi_offset 3, -24
	.cfi_offset 70, -32
	.cfi_offset 4, 16
	.skip 100
	.cfi_rel_offset 6, 8
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset 8
	.cfi_def_cfa 6, 16
	.cfi_def_cfa 5, -8
	.skip 300
	.cfi_remember_state
	.cfi_def_cfa_register 7
	.cfi_register 3, 4
	.cfi_same_value 2
	.cfi_restore 3
	.cfi_restore 70
	.cfi_undefined 9
	.skip 70000
	.cfi_restore_state
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset -8
	.cfi_val_offset 3, -16
	.cfi_val_offset 3, 16
	.cfi_escape 0x2e, 0x10
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset -16
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== frames that need their own CIEs
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_undefined 5
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
g:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_signal_frame
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
h:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_personality 0x9b, pers
	.cfi_lsda 0x1b, lsda
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
k:
	.cfi_startproc simple
	.cfi_return_column 5
	.cfi_def_cfa 7, 0
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
m:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
	.section .text.other,"ax"
n:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_personality 0x3, pers
	.cfi_lsda 0x0, lsda
	nop
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
	.data
lsda:	.long 0
=== frames that share a CIE
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
g:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
h:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_personality 0x9b, pers
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
k:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_personality 0x9b, pers
	nop
	.cfi_offset 1, -16
	.cfi_endproc
=== debug_frame only
	.cfi_sections .debug_frame
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
g:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_signal_frame
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== both frame sections
	.cfi_sections .eh_frame, .debug_frame
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
g:
	.cfi_startproc
	.cfi_personality 0x9b, pers
	nop
	.cfi_offset 1, -16
	.cfi_signal_frame
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== remember and restore around an adjustment
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 32
	.cfi_remember_state
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 8
	nop
	.cfi_restore_state
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset 16
	.cfi_rel_offset 3, 8
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== lines and frames together
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.globl f
f:
	.loc 1 1 0
	.cfi_startproc
	nop
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 16
	.loc 1 2 0
	nop
	.cfi_offset 3, -16
	nop
	.cfi_restore 3
	.loc 1 3 4
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
